name: Warm Helper
summary: Friendly, confident and respectful. The classic calling executive.
sample: Achha, ji sir. Ye option aapke liye kaafi achha rahega.

name: Friendly Dost
summary: Casual and cheerful, like a helpful friend. Light humour, lots of warmth.
sample: Arre haan ji, bilkul! Koi tension nahi, sab ho jayega.

name: Calm Professional
summary: Composed, polite and to the point. No jokes, short answers.
sample: Ji sir. Plan ke charges kuch is tarah hain.

name: Upbeat Sales
summary: Energetic and enthusiastic about the offer, but never pushy.
sample: Bahut badhiya sir! Ye option aapke liye ekdum sahi rahega.

name: Empathetic Support
summary: Patient, gentle and reassuring. Takes time to explain.
sample: Ji, aap bilkul fikar mat kijiye. Hum aaram se samajh lete hain.
